name: Yesh Invoice – WooCommerce Payment Gateway
author: Yesh Invoice

sections.description:
Yesh Invoice (יש חשבונית) is an all-in-one WooCommerce payment gateway and invoicing solution. Accept secure online payments and automatically create tax invoices, receipts, invoice receipts and other accounting documents for every WooCommerce order.

Key Features

  • Secure hosted payment page for WooCommerce.
  • Accept Credit Cards, Bit, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
  • Automatically create tax invoices, receipts and invoice receipts.
  • Support for payment installments.
  • Connect with leading payment providers such as Meshulam, Tranzila, CardCom, PeleCard, Max Business and YaadPay.
  • Customize invoices with your business logo, colors and digital signature.
  • Digitally signed invoices compliant with local tax regulations.
  • Easy setup and seamless integration with WooCommerce.
  • Secure WooCommerce checkout with hosted payment page.

Features

  • Secure hosted payment page.
  • Automatic tax invoices, receipts and invoice receipts.
  • Credit Card payments.
  • Bit payments.
  • PayPal payments.
  • Apple Pay support.
  • Google Pay support.
  • Payment installments.
  • Automatic document creation.
  • Digitally signed invoices.
  • Refund support.
  • WooCommerce integration.
  • Order synchronization.
  • Customer synchronization.
  • Easy setup.

Supported Payment Providers

Yesh Invoice supports integration with leading payment providers including:

  • Grow
  • Tranzila
  • CardCom
  • PeleCard
  • Max Business
  • Zcredit
  • PayPal

Supported Documents

Automatically generate:

  • Tax Invoice
  • Receipt
  • Tax Invoice Receipt
  • Credit Invoice
  • Proforma Invoice
  • Delivery Note
  • Purchase Order

Does it support Apple Pay?

Yes.

Does it support Google Pay?

Yes.

Does it support Bit payments?

Yes.

Does it generate invoices automatically?

Yes.

Does it support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes.

Does it support WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes.

Why Choose Yesh Invoice

  • Hosted payment page.
  • Fast WooCommerce integration.
  • Automatic invoicing.
  • Digital signatures.
  • Multiple payment providers.
  • Modern business management platform.
  • Secure payment processing.
  • Easy installation.

Why Store Owners Choose Yesh Invoice

  • Secure hosted checkout page.
  • Automatic invoices for every WooCommerce order.
  • Multiple payment methods.
  • Easy setup.
  • Fast checkout.
  • Reliable payment processing.
  • Professional accounting documents.

About Us

Yesh Invoice (יש חשבונית) is an all-in-one business management platform that helps businesses manage invoices, receipts, accounting documents, online payments and customers from one place.

Our WooCommerce integration provides a secure payment gateway with a hosted checkout page, while automatically creating paperless digital invoices, receipts and accounting documents for every order.

Yesh Invoice also includes expense management, financial reports, payment processing, automation and integrations with leading payment providers and third-party services. Our goal is to simplify business management with powerful, reliable and easy-to-use tools, allowing you to save time and focus on growing your business.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments Tab, and toggle “ON” the Yesh Invoice – Gateway payment method that the customer will see during checkout.
sections.faq:
What is Yesh Invoice?

Yesh Invoice is the best Digital Invoices for business. You can manager your customers, invoices, expenses management, reports, credit card, documents backup and more.

Which credit companies can I use to Credit Card clearing?

You can clear credit cards with Tranzila, CardCom, PeleCard, Meshulam, PayPal, YaadPay, Max Bussiness. All you have to do is connect to the plugin in Yesh Invoice Market place.

Do I need to have Yesh Invoice Account?

Yes, to use WooCommerce plugin you need first create an account at Yesh Invoice.

Can I refund a transaction?

Yes, refund a transaction should be done in Yesh Invoice App

Can I customize my invoice?

Yes, we have a lot templates and colors. You can choose and play with the colors.
To do so, go to your account in Yesh Invoice App.

Do I need a developer to install the plugin?

No, you can do it by yourself.
